name: Sustained vowel choir drone
desc: A drumless synthetic choir: sawtooth triads held through the vowel formant filter, morphing a-e-i-o-u across five-second cycles as a glacial lpf and opposite-phase pan breathe under a cathedral room. Sparse holds two long chords in slow drift; full re-triggers the voicing to keep a steady breathing body with a gentle saw pump; peak thickens the harmony, adds an octave halo and a faster vowel morph. Meditative, heavenly, breathy. Never silent, never static.

cut.doc: lpf center Hz - the glacial swell orbits this

code.full: n("<[0,2,4]*2 [-3,-1,1]*2 [-1,1,3]*2 [1,3,5]*2>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u a o>").attack(.4).decay(.6).sustain(.7).release(1.6).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).lpq(2).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(2)).pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(24)).room(${room}).roomsize(9).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: n("<[0,2,4,7]*2 [-3,-1,1,4]*2 [-1,1,3,6]*2 [1,3,5,8]*2>").scale("${root}${oct}:${mode}").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u a e o>*2").attack(.3).decay(.5).sustain(.7).release(1.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.9).slow(24)).lpq(2).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.75,${gain}).fast(2)).off(1/2, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.3)).pan(sine.range(.32,.68).slow(16)).room(${room}).roomsize(9).orbit(8).play()
